day_shape: 52 items: coordinated regime signalling of imminent senior military appointments by the Commander-in-Chief, Pezeshkian's readout of a seven-hour Khamenei meeting, Jerusalem Post coverage of the Mecca Joint Defense pact and Hormuz leverage, Uganda approving UPDF deployment to Gaza; nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Iran military command reshuffle signalled
threads.summary: IRIB, Defa Press and Khamenei's office each posted that appointment orders for several senior military commanders by the Commander-in-Chief would be released shortly. Iran International separately reported Mohsen Rezaei's return to a top security post on Sunday.

threads.label: Pezeshkian–Khamenei seven-hour meeting readout
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press carried Pezeshkian's account of a seven-hour meeting with Ayatollah Khamenei, with the president saying the leader was in complete physical health and emphasised preservation of unity and cohesion. Pezeshkian said discussions covered living conditions, employment, housing and problems from the recent war.

threads.label: Mecca pact and Hormuz leverage coverage
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported analysts framing the Mecca Joint Defense Agreement between Pakistan, Turkey and Saudi Arabia and Iran's use of the Strait of Hormuz as leverage tied to a June 17 US memorandum. Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei said Iran saw no reason for concern that the new pact was directed against Tehran.

threads.label: Gaza stabilisation force and Board of Peace plan
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported the Ugandan Parliament approved deploying UPDF troops to Gaza under President Trump's proposed international stabilisation force, while the Meir Amit Institute assessed the Board of Peace's 15-point plan would restrict Israeli responses. Hamas-affiliated analysts dismissed Israel's rejection of the plan, and the IDF urged Gaza residents to replace old banknotes.

threads.label: US posture and Iran negotiations
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Trump's stated intent to 'low-key it' on Iran and UN Ambassador Mike Waltz telling Fox News that Iran feared Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent more than Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. IRIB carried the Foreign Ministry spokesperson's remarks on the timing of the end of negotiations and American conduct.

events.title_en: Haddad Adel: Parliament is the manifestation of national sovereignty and preserves national unity and cohesion
events.summary_en: Member of the Expediency Discernment Council at the 'Law and Legislation in the Thought of the Martyred Leader' conference said: In the Islamic Revolution, the monarchical system was fundamentally denied, overturned and destroyed, but throughout all the years of struggle and in the midst of the revolution, no one ever doubted or questioned the existence of parliament itself. The principle of monarchy was completely abolished and rejected and many structures changed, but throughout all these years no one doubted the necessity of an institution called parliament. Parliament remained as a necessary part of the structure of Islamic governance and was perhaps the only structure that, without being demolished from the previous government, separated.

events.summary_en: Sara Shirazi, ambassador for social responsibility of the Bar Association Centre, said in an interview: So far nearly 10,000 lawyers, specialists and consultants have expressed their readiness to work in the Supporter Plan. The true mission of the Centre became more evident during the 12-day war; because alongside the military struggle, a front of legal, specialist and consultancy services was formed and lawyers, official experts and family consultants moved forward together in this path. We felt that the family issue had been somewhat neglected. For this reason we tried to pursue legal and specialist issues alongside.

events.title_en: IRGC Spokesperson: Defeat of enemy technology before will of Iranian nation / America facing strategic vulnerability for first time
events.summary_en: Commander Mohebati said: America in many past wars had attempted to ensure that the damage caused by war would not reach inside that country; but in the recent war, part of the costs and damage of war was transferred to the opposing side. When the enemy saw that by targeting the supreme leader of the revolution, commanders and some centres, there was no disruption in running the country and public order, it suffered defeat in this arena. The widespread presence of people and display of national solidarity on the streets also showed that the enemy has not been able to achieve its desired perception in society through its military and media operations.

events.title_en: Necessity of drafting guidelines for occasional pardons
events.summary_en: Head of the Judiciary said: Regarding the drafting of a list of occasional pardons, it is necessary, through comprehensive and specialist damage analysis, to draft and circulate clear and defined guidelines. Criticism and critique are very useful and beneficial; but this must be accompanied by logic and appropriate and well-wishing language. In this same category of media and journalism, whose mission is enlightenment and awareness-raising, if overlooked, it may result in the opposite effect and through an incorrect and improper report, create grounds for schism, division and despair among the people, and the enemy may also take advantage of this space.
